story-context.acceptanceCriteria: AC-1: Create User Form - Page Structure at /dashboard/users/new with 8 fields (email, password, confirm password, full_name, default_tenant_id, initial_role, force_password_change, is_active), Cancel button, Create User submit button (disabled until valid) AC-2: Edit User Form - Page Structure at /dashboard/users/{userId}/edit with 5 fields (email, full_name, default_tenant_id, force_password_change, is_active), NO password fields, Save Changes button (disabled until dirty), read-only Current Roles section with "Manage Roles" button AC-3: Form Validation - Real-time validation on blur: Email (required, format, 409 uniqueness), Password (min 8, complexity, strength indicator), Confirm Password (match), Full Name (max 100 chars counter), Tenants/Roles (required), form-level submit disabled until valid AC-4: Form Submission - Create User Flow with POST /api/v1/users, loading state (button disabled + spinner), success (navigate /dashboard/users + toast + auto-scroll), errors (409/400/403/500) AC-5: Form Submission - Edit User Flow with PUT /api/v1/users/{userId} sending only changed fields, loading state, success (toast + mark pristine), errors (400/403/404/409) AC-6: RBAC Enforcement - tenant_admin: pre-select+disable default_tenant_id to their tenant, can assign any role; super_admin: all tenants, all roles; disable Is Active if editing last super_admin AC-7: Cancel and Navigation - Cancel button shows unsaved changes confirmation if dirty, beforeunload event listener for browser back button, options: Stay/Leave Without Saving AC-8: Loading States and Data Fetching - GET /api/v1/users/{userId} with skeleton loader, GET /api/v1/tenants (cached 5min), redirect on 404/403, pre-populate form AC-9: Accessibility and UX - Keyboard navigation (Tab order, Enter submits, Escape cancels), ARIA labels (aria-required, aria-invalid, aria-live), responsive (desktop 2-col, tablet 2-col, mobile 1-col), WCAG 2.1 AA contrast + focus indicators AC-10: Performance and Security - Form validation debounced 150ms, password strength debounced 300ms, tenants cached 5min, autocomplete attributes (email: "username email", password: "new-password"), CSRF JWT, network retry exponential backoff (2s/4s/8s)

docs.doc: Pre-implementation requirements completed: User research (5 personas), Figma design system with design-tokens.json, ADRs (001-006). React Hook Form + Zod is standard validation pattern. JWT architecture: roles on-demand (not in JWT). API versioning: /api/v1/*.

Backend APIs available: POST /api/v1/users (UserCreateDTO with initial_role), PUT /api/v1/users/{id} (UserUpdateDTO), GET /api/v1/users/{id}, POST /api/v1/users/{id}/reset-password. RBAC: super_admin sees all, tenant_admin scoped to default_tenant_id. Constraints: last super_admin protection, tenant boundaries enforced.

Users list page integrates "Create User" button → /dashboard/users/new, "Edit" button → /dashboard/users/{userId}/edit. After create/edit, redirect to /dashboard/users. React Query patterns: staleTime 60s, optimistic updates with rollback. Custom Select component (NOT shadcn/ui SelectContent). TypeScript strict mode required. 80%+ test coverage target.

Auth.js session management, JWT tokens, 5 roles (super_admin, tenant_admin, developer, operator, viewer). Middleware protection redirects non-admin to /dashboard. Tenant isolation via default_tenant_id scoping.

story-context.constraints: - React Hook Form + Zod is the ONLY validation pattern allowed (no Formik, no manual state) - Use custom Select component pattern from UserFilters.tsx (NOT shadcn/ui SelectContent/SelectItem) - TypeScript strict mode required, all imports case-sensitive (@/components/ui/Select capital S) - Single reusable UserForm component with mode prop ('create' | 'edit') to avoid duplication - Password fields ONLY in create mode, never shown in edit mode (use Reset Password button instead) - RBAC enforcement: tenant_admin cannot create users outside their tenant, super_admin sees all tenants - Disable "Is Active" checkbox if editing last active super_admin (prevent lockout) - Unsaved changes confirmation MUST be implemented (beforeunload + Cancel button) - Form validation debounced (150ms general, 300ms password strength) to avoid excessive re-renders - Optimistic UI updates for mutations with rollback on error - Minimum 80% test coverage for form components and hooks - All files ≤500 lines per C1 constraint, use modular design for form fields

interfaces.interface: Response: UserDetailDTO { id, email, full_name, default_tenant_id, is_active, force_password_change, roles, last_login, created_at, updated_at } Errors: 404 Not Found, 403 Forbidden (RBAC)
Response: TenantDTO[] { id: UUID, name: string, created_at, updated_at } Cache: React Query staleTime 5 minutes (AC-10)

Props: mode ('create' | 'edit'), initialData (User object for edit mode) Validation: Zod schema (createUserSchema for create, editUserSchema for edit) State: React Hook Form useForm() with zodResolver Events: onSubmit (create/update mutation), onCancel (navigation confirmation if dirty)

tests.standards: Jest + React Testing Library for unit tests (components, hooks). Playwright for E2E integration tests. Mock API responses with MSW. Test coverage target: 80%+. Test files in nextjs-ui/__tests__/users/. Pattern: Arrange-Act-Assert with descriptive test names.
tests.ideas: AC-1: Test create form renders with all 8 fields, default values (force_password_change=true, is_active=true, initial_role=viewer) AC-2: Test edit form renders with 5 fields, NO password fields, pre-populated data from initialData prop AC-3: Test email validation (required, format, blur event), password validation (min 8, complexity, strength indicator weak/medium/strong), confirm password match, full name max 100 chars counter AC-4: Test create mutation success (navigate + toast + API call with correct payload), test errors (409 email exists shows inline, 403 shows toast, 500 shows form-level error) AC-5: Test edit mutation success (toast + mark pristine + only changed fields sent), test errors (400 last admin, 403/404 redirect, 409 inline) AC-6: Test tenant_admin RBAC (tenant dropdown disabled + pre-selected), test super_admin RBAC (all tenants available), test Is Active disabled for last super_admin AC-7: Test Cancel button with pristine form (immediate navigate), test Cancel with dirty form (shows confirmation dialog), test beforeunload event listener AC-8: Test edit page loading states (skeleton → form), test 404/403 error redirects to list page with toast AC-9: Test keyboard navigation (Tab order, Enter submits, Escape cancels), test ARIA attributes (aria-required, aria-invalid, aria-live), test responsive breakpoints AC-10: Test form validation debounce (150ms), test password strength debounce (300ms), test optimistic update rollback on mutation error
